messages:
sam_cs: Heads up: new customer Atlas sees a burst of 429s in staging during onboarding when they enable client-side preview. Most requests succeed after 1 retry. Can we quick-triage?

ila_sdk: likely preflight fanout + ephemeral token churn. Which SDK & auth flow?

sam_cs: browser-preview-sdk v0.9.0, server mints ephemeral per tab (TTL ~15s). They kick off 6 concurrent preview requests on page load.

matt_eng: pattern = stampede. Short-term: ask them to limit concurrency to 2-3, reuse ephemeral tokens for 30-60s, add jittered exponential backoff. We can also offer a temporary preflight uplift for tenant A-312.

ram_oncall: I can apply a 2-hour preflight bump and enable tenant-level request logs. Ops-bot will create ticket. Approve?

sam_cs: yes please. Scheduling a 15m enablement call to walk mitigations.

ops-bot: ticket CS-11880 created; temporary preflight uplift applied for tenant A-312; request logs enabled.

ram_oncall: monitoring: preflight 429s dropping ~25% after uplift. Will revert after customer confirms staged rollout.

ila_sdk: will send a short client checklist for the call: cap concurrency, token pooling, http2 keepalive, and retry jitter/snippet.

sam_cs: thanks team — will post outcome here after the call.
